final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT orderslink AS reference, AVG(feerate - rebrate) AS group_average, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM fees GROUP BY orderslink), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(group_average) AS overall_average FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT step1.reference, step1.group_average, step1.record_count, step1.group_average - step2.overall_average AS difference FROM step1 CROSS JOIN step2 WHERE step2.overall_average IS NOT NULL AND step1.group_average > step2.overall_average) SELECT AVG(group_average), AVG(record_count), AVG(difference) FROM step3
